text:
tay-cs: FYI  NorthHarbor renewal needs special handling. They want to keep 15% of payment deferred and tied to SLA uptime (performance credit), request Net60 terms for the deferred portion, and want our delegated-signer clause for procurement. Legal + finance + billing input before we draft addendum.

amos-acct: Numbers: current ARR $120,000 (1,000 seats). Proposed: 12mo, keep pricing, defer 15% until end of quarter subject to 99.9% uptime; deferred portion payable Net60 after verification.

diane-legal: Performance-credit terms ok but must be precise: measurement window, verification method (logs/traces), dispute resolution, and cap. Delegated-signer allowed but restrict to invoice acceptance only; procurement mailbox isn't acceptable as delegation unless named delegates provided. Also watch GDPR if verification requires sharing logs.

julia-finance: Finance concerns: Net60 on deferred funds increases credit exposure. Need credit-app for exposure >$60k; this account is at risk. Also require clear payment waterfall: upfront 85% on Net30, deferred 15% Net60 after reconciliation. We should add late-fee terms for the deferred tranche.

henry-billing: Billing ops: system supports split-payment schedules via milestone billing. We'll need a billing profile change and a verification webhook from our monitoring to trigger deferred invoice. That will take ~72h to set up. If customer insists, we can manual process one cycle. Need exact SLA metric and verification method.

ops-se: From SE: Verification should use our existing uptime dashboard snapshots and signed-off metrics export. Recommend we include a one-time technical attestation step to avoid disputes. Also suggest including a 5-business-day dispute window after verification.

tay-cs: Customer provided procurement contact and agrees to named delegates. They accepted technical attestation. They asked we avoid publishing full bank wiring on contract; prefer invoice-only wiring.

diane-legal: I'll draft an addendum with: (1) 15% deferred tranche language, (2) SLA measurement and verification process, (3) dispute resolution timing, (4) delegated-signer paragraph limited to named procurement delegates, and (5) payment waterfall with late-fee for deferred tranche.

julia-finance: Finance: require credit-app due to Net60 exposure; we'll generate link. Approve draft once posted. Also need billing entity confirmation and tax IDs for AR.

henry-billing: Will queue billing ops ticket to provision milestone billing + webhook. If legal approves, schedule change for Tue morning; manual fallback available.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 5109876390 "NorthHarbor Performance Credit Addendum" pre-created awaiting legal upload.

tay-cs: Plan: 1) Diane to post draft by EOD; 2) Julia to confirm credit-app requirement & send link; 3) Henry to prep billing ops ticket; 4) send DocuSign after legal + finance sign-off. Marking renewal as "at-risk" if DocuSign not launched in 48h.
